description: 臺南市土壤液化資訊 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺南市政府工務局. 臺南市土壤液化潛勢圖分為3級，顯示在5~6級震度下，土壤發生液化的機率及影響。 以液化潛能指數PL值判定，將調查區域分成紅、黃、綠3種等級，相關資料以現有調查數據公開，相關網址 liquid. net. tw/tainan/main/index. aspx. Coverage: 臺南市政府工務局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺南市政府工務局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
